name: How long does a typical roof replacement estimate take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical roof replacement estimate take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for a roof replacement estimate can vary depending on the complexity and accessibility of your roof. A standard inspection for a residential property often takes about 30 to 60 minutes. During this time, our team will measure the roof, assess its current condition, and identify any damage. We strive to provide a detailed estimate promptly after the on-site visit, often within 24-48 hours, allowing you to review it without significant delay.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical on-site roof replacement estimate takes 30-60 minutes, with the detailed estimate usually provided within 24-48 hours after the visit.
